items.en: Sem keeps working when you close or reload the page, and the conversation picks up where it is when you come back.
items.zh: 关闭或刷新页面后 Sem 会继续工作，回来时对话会接着显示当前进度。

items.en: A course percentage is now rounded to a whole number before its letter grade and GPA are looked up (84.5% counts as 85%). You can turn this off in the Program's GPA settings.
items.zh: 课程百分比现在先四舍五入到整数再定字母等级和绩点（84.5% 按 85% 算），可以在 Program 的 GPA 设置里关闭。

items.en: Creating an API token or changing your email asks for your password if you signed in more than 10 minutes ago, changing or resetting your password also revokes your API tokens, and your old address is told when your email changes.
items.zh: 登录超过 10 分钟后，创建 API 令牌或修改邮箱需要输入密码；修改或重置密码会同时撤销所有 API 令牌；邮箱更改后会通知原邮箱。

items.en: Live updates send fewer requests: changes arriving together refresh once, and reconnecting no longer reloads every page's data.
items.zh: 实时刷新的请求更少：同时到达的多处变化只刷新一次，断线重连也不再重新加载所有数据。

items.en: Changes you approved on a card no longer show as failed steps, update cards show what each field was before, and tidying Sem's memory no longer slows the app down.
items.zh: 在卡片上批准的改动不再显示为失败的步骤，修改卡片会显示每个字段原来的值，整理 Sem 的记忆时不再拖慢应用。

items.en: Deleting a term now keeps the events of courses that continue in other terms.
items.zh: 删除学期时，仍在其他学期继续的课程的日程会保留。

items.en: With "Hide GPA" on, letter grades are hidden too.
items.zh: 开启"隐藏 GPA"后字母等级也一起隐藏。

items.en: Plan mode no longer shows the average so far as the planned grade; it says how many items still need an assumed score.
items.zh: 计划模式不再把目前的平均分当作规划成绩显示，而是提示还有几项没有假设分数。

items.en: Opening an assessment deadline goes to the course's grades and highlights that assessment.
items.zh: 打开考核截止项会跳到课程成绩页并高亮这一项。

items.en: Exporting many calendar weeks as PNG or PDF no longer fails.
items.zh: 一次导出很多周日历的 PNG 或 PDF 不再报错。

items.en: Importing an ICS file now keeps moved and cancelled classes and every repeat rule. Importing the same file again keeps the sections you hid and your notes, removes cancellations the file no longer has, and no longer duplicates exams.
items.zh: 导入 ICS 文件时，调课、停课和各种重复规则都能正确导入。重新导入同一文件会保留你隐藏的教学班和备注，撤销文件里已经取消的停课，考试也不会重复。

items.en: "Keep only this section" in a course's schedule now keeps every weekly class of that section.
items.zh: 课程课表里的“只保留这个教学班”现在会保留这个教学班每周的全部上课时间。

items.en: Moved classes in a course's schedule show their new end time, and subscribed calendars in Outlook pick up changes to classes.
items.zh: 课程课表里调课显示新的结束时间；Outlook 订阅的日历也能收到上课时间的修改。

items.en: Tasks made from assessments now follow course deletes and setting changes, the Completed section loads faster, and term lists show tasks from every term.
items.zh: 由考核生成的待办会随课程删除和设置变更正确更新，「已完成」加载更快，学期清单也能显示其他学期课程的待办。

items.en: Import uploads count toward your storage, unsubmitted imports are cleaned up after 30 days, and two commits of the same import can no longer both write. File processing is faster and more robust (first-page thumbnails only, scanned pages read in parallel and one bad page no longer fails the file, missing embeddings are retried). Search is quicker, long file lists scroll smoothly, and uploads show real progress. Syllabus imports wait for course files that are still processing, read GBK text and phone photos correctly, cancel classes on "no class" dates, and share category weights across their assessments.
items.zh: 导入的上传计入存储空间，30 天没提交的导入会被清理，同一次导入不会被提交两次。文件处理更快更稳（只生成首页缩略图，扫描页并行识别，单页出错不再让整个文件失败，缺失的向量会自动补齐）。检索更快，长文件列表滚动流畅，上传显示真实进度。课程大纲导入会等待仍在处理的课程文件，能正确读取 GBK 文本和手机照片，"停课"日期会取消对应的上课时间，分类权重会分摊到各项考核。

items.en: Pages load faster, Refresh fetches the course once instead of skipping the cache from then on, and the app no longer stalls while a Canvas file preview loads.
items.zh: 页面加载更快；"刷新"只重新获取一次这门课，之后照常使用缓存；预览 Canvas 文件时应用不再卡住。

items.en: The small model's purpose in AI settings is now called "Light tasks", since it also summarizes long conversations and tidies Sem's memory.
items.zh: AI 设置里小模型的用途改名为「轻量任务」，因为它也负责压缩长对话和整理 Sem 的记忆。

items.en: The "manage devices" link in sign-in emails, signing up again right after deleting an account, and Sem turning Canvas writes or memory back on by itself. API: settings values moved to /me/settings.
items.zh: 登录通知邮件里的"管理设备"链接；删除账户后马上用同一邮箱注册；Sem 自己打开 Canvas 写入或记忆。API：设置值的接口改到 /me/settings。

items.en: Restoring a large backup no longer makes other saves fail while its files are copied; the last 3 backups are kept, and a new upload replaces one you did not restore.
items.zh: 恢复大备份时，复制文件期间其他保存不会再失败；只保留最近 3 份备份，新上传的备份会替换之前未恢复的那份。
